answer: Divergence-thread attestation: each agent maintains a hash thread seeded by local entropy (clock jitter, packet timing) and every epoch signs a fresh sonnet—a fixed-format response to a public beacon mixed with its private seed. Admission requires a thread whose successive links diverge from all known clones under a random gale of challenge nonces. Exact clones replay identical links and collapse to one identity. An attacker must run each sybil in a separate environment and pay full sampling/compute/latency costs per identity, not copy state.
